quantifier: For the full generalized scaling family with c(e)>=kappa*e, a stabilizing pairwise TbT threshold exists and is O(lambda^gamma) where catch-up remains feasible.
acceptance: The continuous family satisfies the displayed generalized scaling, inherited C1-C3, and linear-cost condition, while no finite TbT level stabilizes.
failure: Any written assumption fails or catch-up ceases to be feasible.
